name: COMO Metropolitan Singapore
insider_take: Sleek, soulful, and effortlessly sophisticated — COMO Metropolitan Singapore is a sanctuary of calm nestled in the heart of one of Asia's most electrifying cities.
whats_special: Occupying a prime spot on Bras Basah Road near the iconic Singapore Art Museum, this boutique-style luxury hotel blends contemporary design with COMO's signature wellness philosophy. The renowned COMO Shambhala Urban Escape offers transformative spa treatments, while the celebrated Spathe Public House and COMO Cuisine deliver exceptional farm-to-table dining. With just 156 rooms and suites, guests enjoy an intimate, personalized experience rarely found in a city-center hotel.
pro_tip: Book a COMO Shambhala spa treatment early in your stay — therapists will tailor a wellness program around your entire visit, making every day feel like a reset.
dont_miss: Step outside and you're moments from the Singapore Art Museum , the leafy Fort Canning Park , and the buzzing galleries and boutiques of the Bras Basah.Bugis arts precinct — Singapore's most culturally rich neighborhood.
pros: Prime Orchard Road location puts world-class shopping, dining, and city attractions at your doorstep
Renowned COMO Shambhala Urban Escape spa offering holistic wellness treatments and therapies
Sleek, minimalist design with spacious, elegantly appointed rooms and suites
Award-winning cuisine at Cassia restaurant, celebrated for its refined Cantonese culinary experience
Intimate boutique atmosphere with highly personalized and attentive service
cons: Compact pool area may feel limited during peak periods
Boutique scale means fewer on-site amenities compared to larger luxury resort properties
